label: Process
description: A BFO process (occurrent): an entity that unfolds in time, e.g. an observation, a program execution, a governance activity.

label: Independent Continuant
description: A BFO independent continuant: a bearer of qualities that persists through time.

label: Artifact
description: A CCO artifact: an object intentionally made to realize a function (instruments, systems, datasets-as-objects).

label: Generically Dependent Continuant
description: A BFO generically dependent continuant: a continuant that depends on one or more bearers and can migrate between them (information, patterns, designs).

label: Information Content Entity
description: A CCO information content entity: a generically dependent continuant that is about, or carries information concerning, some entity.

label: Quality
description: A BFO quality: a specifically dependent continuant that is exhibited whenever its bearer exists (a measurable/observable attribute).

label: Role
description: A BFO role: a realizable specifically dependent continuant a bearer has in virtue of external circumstances (physician role, foreign-key role).

label: Disposition
description: A BFO disposition: a realizable entity grounded in the bearer's physical make-up (a capacity or tendency to be realized in a process).

label: Material Entity
description: A BFO material entity: an independent continuant that has matter as a part.

label: Descriptive Information Content Entity
description: An ICE that describes an entity or state of affairs (measurements, records, observations).

label: Directive Information Content Entity
description: An ICE that prescribes or directs (plans, rules, requirements, policies).

label: Designative Information Content Entity
description: An ICE that designates or names an entity (identifiers, codes, keys).

label: Generic Entity
description: Foundational / domain-agnostic axiom patterns without a specific BFO/CCO anchor.

Every {ParentingRole} stands in the inheres in relation to exactly one {DisabledAdult}, and the is realized in relation to at least one {ParentingActivity}.

A directive information content entity operates as a BeneficiaryDesignation when it designates a DesignatedBeneficiary and governs a RetirementBenefitOption. label: Clinical Quality Improvement Program

label: Vector Control Activity

Exactly one LegalEntityOrPerson bears a DataControllerRole, an agent_role that realizes the DataDeterminationFunction responsible for determining purposes and means regarding personal data processing. label: Strap Fixing Process

The execution of a StrapFixingProcess consists of two actions within a BFO process framework: attaching a LateralRestraintStrap and securing it to a BuildingFloorStructure. label: Credit Hour Certification Process
description: An occurrent classified as a CreditHourCertificationProcess must participate in an AcademicTerm. label: Athletic Attendant Role

label: Conference Programme
description: A conference programme qualifies as an information content entity precisely when it contains_presentation at least one academic presentation. The contains_presentation relation links a conference programme to an academic presentation, establishing the former as an information content entity. In the ontology, a conference programme must be modeled as an information content entity that carries a contains_presentation link to an academic presentation.
axiom: Class: {ConferenceProgramme:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000958 and sdg:contains_presentation some {AcademicPresentation:Class}

label: Scientific Organization
description: An artifact qualifies as a scientific organization if and only if it publishes_journal an academic journal and organizes_meetings a scientific meeting. The relation publishes_journal connects a scientific organization to an academic journal, while the relation organizes_meetings connects the same organization to a scientific meeting, identifying the entity as an artifact. To operate as a scientific organization, an artifact must execute the action publishes_journal upon an academic journal and execute the action organizes_meetings upon a scientific meeting.
axiom: Class: {ScientificOrganization:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:publishes_journal some {AcademicJournal:Class} and sdg:organizes_meetings some {ScientificMeeting:Class}

label: Donor Profile

label: Donation Transaction Record

(Relational-fronted) The involvement of a Donor, the allocation to a GiftAllocationPurpose, and the holding of a monetary value define an InformationContentEntity recognized as a DonationTransaction
axiom: Class: {DonationTransactionRecord:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000958 and sdg:involvesDonor some {Donor:Class} and sdg:allocatesTo some {GiftAllocationPurpose:Class} and sdg:hasMonetaryValue some xsd:decimal

label: Education Health Care Plan

label: Educational Placement Process

A Student is affected and a Curriculum is produced by an EducationalPlacementProcess, which is an Occurrent. An EducationalPlacementProcess functions as an Occurrent by affecting a Student and producing a Curriculum.
axiom: Class: {EducationalPlacementProcess:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:affectsStudent some {Student:Class} and sdg:producesCurriculum some {Curriculum:Class}

label: Provider Change Request Process
description: A ProviderChangeRequestProcess belongs to the Process category and simultaneously holds a RequestingClient while designating a RequestedProviderType. For any entity classified as a ProviderChangeRequestProcess, it is necessarily a Process that contains a RequestingClient and points to a RequestedProviderType. A ProviderChangeRequestProcess belongs to the Process class and necessarily includes a RequestingClient alongside a RequestedProviderType that it targets.

label: Ozone Therapy Session
description: The OzoneTherapySession is defined as a process that administers an OzoneOxygenMixture and utilizes an AutohemotherapyProcedure. During an OzoneTherapySession, the process administers an OzoneOxygenMixture and utilizes an AutohemotherapyProcedure. The administration of an OzoneOxygenMixture and the utilization of an AutohemotherapyProcedure together constitute an OzoneTherapySession as a process.

label: Storage Allocation
description: A StorageAllocation is a descriptive information content entity that allocates to exactly one Student and provides exactly one CloudStorageVolume.
axiom: Class: {StorageAllocation:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000853 and sdg:allocatesTo exactly 1 {Student:Class} and sdg:providesResource exactly 1 {CloudStorageVolume:Class}

label: Measurement Capability
description: Every MeasurementCapability qualifies as an InformationContentEntity by possessing a MeasurementParameter, a MeasurementRange, and a decimal ExpandedUncertainty. The presence of a MeasurementParameter, a MeasurementRange, and a decimal ExpandedUncertainty characterizes a MeasurementCapability as an InformationContentEntity. Every executive leadership role, serving as an organizational leadership role, maintains a member relationship with at least one executive leadership process. To qualify as an executive leadership role, an entity must first function as an organizational leadership role and must include at least one executive leadership process as a member.
axiom: Class: {ExecutiveLeadershipRole:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:OrganizationalLeadershipRole and sdg:hasMember some sdg:ExecutiveLeadershipProcess

label: External Business Partner
description: An interpersonal relationship role is defined by its connection to an external agency and its participation in market exchange with an independent economic agent. To qualify as this type of interpersonal relationship role, the role must maintain a relationship with an external agency and conduct market exchange with an independent economic agent. An external agency relates to an interpersonal relationship role, which simultaneously engages in market exchange with an independent economic agent.
axiom: Class: {ExternalBusinessPartner:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000599 and sdg:hasRelationship some sdg:ExternalAgency and sdg:engages_in_market_exchange some sdg:IndependentEconomicAgent

label: Financial Instrument
description: A financial instrument constitutes a specific category of financial product defined by its realization of a clearing function. The clearing function is realized by a financial instrument, which operates as a type of financial product. A financial product is designated as a financial instrument upon the realization of a clearing function.
axiom: Class: {FinancialInstrument:Class} EquivalentTo: sdg:FinancialProduct and bfo:0000056 some {ClearingFunction:Class}

label: Financial Strategy Oversight
description: A process classified under this category is defined by its participation within a financial management process. When modeling this entity, treat it as a process that participates in a financial management process. A process classified under this term is defined by its participation within a financial management process.
axiom: Class: {FinancialStrategyOversight:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and bfo:0000056 some sdg:FinancialManagementProcess

label: Higher Education Institution
description: An entity is classified as an educational organization that confers academic degrees if and only if it functions as an educational organization and confers academic degrees. (Definitional) Verification of an educational organization that confers academic degrees requires confirming that the entity operates as an educational organization and confers academic degrees. (Procedural)
axiom: Class: {HigherEducationInstitution:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000564 and sdg:confersAcademicDegree some cco:ont00002003

label: Institutional Investor
description: A material entity is defined as a material entity that provides investor funding for financial situations. The provision of investor funding for financial situations is performed by a material entity. Investor funding for financial situations is supplied by a material entity.
axiom: Class: {InstitutionalInvestor:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:providesInvestorFunding some sdg:InvestorFundingSituation

label: Legal Proceeding
description: A legal system act is defined as an act that involves court documents. Court documents are involved in a legal system act. Involvement with court documents characterizes a legal system act.
axiom: Class: {LegalProceeding:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001314 and sdg:involvesCourtDocument some sdg:CourtDocument

label: Network User
description: A material entity is characterized by its use of a computer network. The use of a computer network applies to a material entity. Identification of a material entity relies on its use of a computer network.
axiom: Class: {NetworkUser:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:usesNetwork some cco:ont00000700

label: Observation Function
description: An observation artifact function that enables visible observation.
axiom: Class: {ObservationFunction:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00001306 and sdg:enablesObservation some cco:ont00000889

label: Organization
description: A material entity is defined as an entity that possesses organization members. Organization members are possessed by a material entity. A material entity maintains organization members within its scope.
axiom: Class: {Organization:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000040 and sdg:hasMember some cco:ont00000647

label: Organizational Culture
description: An organization capability that inheres in an organization.
axiom: Class: {OrganizationalCulture:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000568 and sdg:inheresInOrganization some sdg:Organization

label: Original Document
description: A document content entity is defined as the source of information content for a copied document. The source of information content for a copied document is a document content entity. A document content entity serves as the source of information content for a copied document.
axiom: Class: {OriginalDocument:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00002039 and sdg:isSourceOfInformationContentFor some sdg:CopiedDocument

label: Pdf Format
description: A quality is defined by its application to a PDF document. A PDF document is the entity that receives application from a quality. A quality applies to a PDF document.
axiom: Class: {PdfFormat:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000019 and sdg:appliesToDocument some sdg:PdfDocument

label: Personally Identifiable Information
description: An information content entity serves as the means by which a person is identified. The identification of a person is performed by an information content entity. An information content entity must function to identify a person.
axiom: Class: {PersonallyIdentifiableInformation:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000958 and sdg:identifiesPerson some bfo:0000040

label: Population
description: A collection of persons is defined as this class when it functions as the subject of a prevalence rate. The subject of a prevalence rate is identified as a group of persons. A set of individuals is classified as this entity by assuming the role of subject for a prevalence rate.
axiom: Class: {Population:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00000914 and sdg:isSubjectOfPrevalenceRate some sdg:PrevalenceRate

label: Professional Experience
description: A process is defined as any entity that necessarily incorporates professional practice. Any process must satisfy the requirement of encompassing professional practice.
axiom: Class: {ProfessionalExperience:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:involvesProfessionalPractice some sdg:PracticeSession

label: Qualification Level
description: An academic degree is characterized by its indication of statistical significance. Indication of statistical significance is a defining attribute of an academic degree. An academic degree indicates statistical
axiom: Class: {QualificationLevel:Class} EquivalentTo: cco:ont00002003 and sdg:indicatesStatisticalSignificance some sdg:SignificanceLevel

label: Raffle

(Definitional) This procedure operates by distributing prizes via lot numbers. (Procedural) A process that distributes prizes via lot numbers is a procedure defined by its distribution of prizes via lot numbers.
axiom: Class: {Raffle:Class} EquivalentTo: bfo:0000015 and sdg:distributesPrizesViaLotNumber some cco:ont00001309

label: Age
description: A temporal quality is defined as the measure of how long existence has persisted from a designated starting point. The duration of existence from a designated starting point is quantified by a temporal quality. A temporal quality is mandated to measure the length of existence originating from a particular starting point.
axiom: Class: {Age:Class} SubClassOf: bfo:0000019

label: Continuous Mode
description: A monitoring system sustains uninterrupted operation across the specified interval by assuming this role.
axiom: Class: {ContinuousMode:Class} SubClassOf: bfo:0000023

label: Risk Management Activity
description: A corporate process is defined as the identification, assessment, and mitigation of potential hazards or uncertainties. The corporate process operates by identifying, assessing, and mitigating potential hazards or uncertainties. Potential hazards or uncertainties are subject to identification, assessment, and mitigation within a corporate process.
axiom: Class: {RiskManagementActivity:Class} SubClassOf: sdg:FinancialManagementProcess

label: Chemical
description: A material entity consists exclusively of either a chemical substance or a mixture. When categorizing a material entity, assign it the type chemical substance or the type mixture. Every material entity must be identified as either a chemical substance or a mixture.
axiom: Class: {Chemical:Class} SubClassOf: bfo:0000040

label: School Security Policy
description: A specifically dependent continuant specifies rules and procedures for security within a school environment. (Simple declarative) Rules and procedures for security within a school environment are specified by a specifically dependent continuant. (Passive/relational-fronted) The specification of rules and procedures for security within a school environment is assigned to a specifically dependent continuant. (Nominalized/procedural)

label: Scientific Organization
description: An organization qualifies under this definition when its principal aim is either conducting or supporting scientific research and development. To be classified as such, an organization must have its main objective directed toward carrying out or backing scientific research and development. The primary purpose of an organization is established as conducting or supporting scientific research and development.
axiom: Class: {ScientificOrganization:Class} SubClassOf: cco:ont00001180

label: Service Level Agreement
description: A specifically dependent continuant is an entity that establishes the expected service metrics, responsibilities, and standards governing the relationship between a service provider and a client. The expected service metrics, responsibilities, and standards between a service provider and a client are defined by a specifically dependent continuant. When specifying the expected service metrics, responsibilities, and standards between a service provider and a client, a specifically dependent continuant serves as the defining element.

label: State Action
description: StateAction derives its basis as an Act of Government. An Act of Government serves as the ground for StateAction. Grounding StateAction means classifying it as an Act of Government. (Adds "classifying" - risky)

label: Tariff Structure

label: Vulnerability State
